mcp-abap-adt/search.semantic: Run ABAP Unit tests of classes or programs.

description: [read-only] ABAP Unit test run. Required: tests[]{container_class*, test_class*}. Optional: runner (async | sync, default async), title, context, scope, risk_level, duration. Response: JSON — runner async: { success, run_id }, the status and result read later by run_id, suited to long suites; runner sync: { success, runner, finished, run_result }, the finished result of every test class of each container_class in one request. When runner is sync; or runner is async (absent reads as async), recordable: in batch mode a call is recorded under the next number and answers with empty content; its answer is read by number after the batch ends.

context.description: Run context label; sent by the async runner.

runner.description: async (default): starts the run and returns its run_id, whose status and result are read by run_id; suited to long suites. sync: one request that runs every test class of each container_class and returns the finished result.

add_foreign_tests_as_preview.description: Preview foreign tests without full inclusion.

tests.description: List of test classes to run.

title.description: Run title shown in ABAP Unit test logs; sent by the async runner.

name: HandlerUnitTestRun
